"    def _build_trade_card(self, position):
        profit = position["profit"]
        side_is_buy = "BUY" in position["type"]
        
        if side_is_buy:
            accent = "#10b981"
            chip_bg = "#10b98115"
            chip_text = f"买入 {position['volume']:.2f}手"
        else:
            accent = "#f43f5e"
            chip_bg = "#f43f5e15"
            chip_text = f"卖出 {position['volume']:.2f}手"
            
        return self._list_card(
            accent=accent,
            icon=ft.Icons.SHOW_CHART,
            title=ft.Row(
                [
                    ft.Text(position["symbol"], size=13, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color=ft.Colors.WHITE),
                    self._chip(chip_text, accent, chip_bg),
                ],
                spacing=8,
            ),
            subtitle=ft.Text(
                f"{position['time']} | 价格: {position['price_open']} | 盈亏: {profit:+,.2f}",
                size=11,
                color="#99a2ad",
            ),
            right=ft.Container(
                content=ft.Text(
                    f"{profit:+,.2f}",
                    size=14,
                    weight=ft.FontWeight.W_900,
                    color=self._profit_color(profit),
                ),
                shadow=ft.BoxShadow(
                    blur_radius=8,
                    color=f"{self._profit_color(profit)}22",
                ) if profit != 0 else None,
            ),
        )"
